html:
Ninh Binh in November, the weather starts to turn into winter, a bit chilly, the sky is clear and there is no rain, and many tourists choose Ninh Binh as a destination for their vacation. However, if you are the first person to set foot in Ninh Binh, you will surely wonder what is beautiful about traveling to Ninh Binh in November? So please read the article below.

Ninh Binh not only brings tourists scenic spots or sacred temples, but when coming here, tourists also encounter poetic scenes, unique cultures, especially immersing themselves in annual festivals will bring tourists a memorable vacation.

Places tourists should visit when traveling to Ninh Binh in November

Van Long Lagoon

Coming here, you will be immersed in the beautiful natural scenery, full of life, especially when you sit on the boats to admire the poetic scenery, looking like a charming landscape painting.

Thung Nham Bird Garden

Located about 4 km from Tam Coc scenic area, it is home to many species of birds such as: Storks, herons, teals, magpies… including many species listed in the Red Book of flamingos and phoenixes… the most beautiful is when in the evening flocks of birds fly back to their nests under the sunset, creating a beautiful scene for you to check in.

Trang An

Traveling to Trang An in November, you will be immersed in a unique festival, or sitting on boats to admire the poetic scenery, surrounded by high, overlapping rocky mountains, below is the clear blue water. Tourists sitting on boats gliding through the scenic spots will feel their souls truly comfortable, a poetic beauty that this place brings to visitors.

Bich Dong Pagoda

Located right at the foot of the mountain, with its back leaning against the mountain, facing the immense lake, surrounded by rows of cool green trees, and high rocky mountains creating a beautiful and peaceful scene.

What to eat when traveling to Ninh Binh in November?

Ninh Binh crispy rice

A famous dish, cooked from fried rice with a golden color through the skillful hands of the chef, has created delicious flavors unique to the cuisine of the North. Especially when going on a tour Ninh Binh in November in the cool weather, it is very suitable to enjoy crispy rice, a famous specialty.

Ninh Binh mountain goat

Goats here are raised by people on the mountains, so the meat is firm and delicious and through talented chefs are bringing diners an irresistible delicious flavor, goats can be processed into dishes such as: Raw goat with lemon, grilled goat with cast iron, Spicy goat stir-fry, Goat sauce ….

Ninh Binh mountain snails

Snails often live in caves and are most abundant during the rainy season, snails are fragrant and very crispy and are processed into many dishes such as: Grilled, stir-fried, boiled with lemongrass, steamed with ginger … all bring their own delicious flavors.

Gia Vien Shrimp Paste
Shrimp paste, also known as shrimp paste, sour sauce, is made from freshwater shrimp and Gia Vien water, so it has its own unique flavor and attractive aroma, often used to dip meat, vegetables or vermicelli.

Cai sauce

Made from fresh and delicious crabs, processed very elaborately, the crabs are caught and soaked in rice water, then crushed and put in a jar for 1 week… eaten with boiled vegetables, it looks simple but brings a unique delicious flavor, a famous specialty.

So with the experience of traveling to Ninh Binh in November that Vietlook Travel has shared with you, we hope you will choose for yourself the best tour, let’s come to Ninh Binh today.
